title: Onboarding checklist length test
description: Compares a 3, 5 and 7 step onboarding checklist for new signups, scored on activation within 7 days.
markdown:
# Onboarding checklist length test ## Description Compares a 3, 5 and 7 step onboarding checklist for new signups, scored on activation within 7 days. ## Steps ### Step 1: Set up the checklist length test Create a CLIENT EXPERIMENT on /experiences titled "Onboarding Checklist Length". ═══ PATH 1: Top-level configuration ═══ Experience type: client_experiment Variants: - Control (34%): 3 steps: Connect data, Invite team, Create first report - Variant B (33%): 5 steps: adds Set goals, Customize dashboard - Variant C (33%): 7 steps: adds Watch tutorial, Configure notifications Targeting: - Pages: in-app dashboard URL where the onboarding checklist component renders - Audience: new signups only: segment definition: User created within 24 hours - Devices: any - Display frequency: always (during user's first session) or once (sticky to first visit) Primary metric: goal_completed_in_experience where experience_id = (the goal fires when the user completes their nominated activation milestone within 7 days of exposure) Secondary metrics: - Click on per checklist step (per-step completion rate) - Completed a journey goal within 7 days (existing activation journey completion) - Session start day-2 / day-7 (engagement after onboarding) Guardrail: 14-day Session start retention must not drop >3 percentage points Schedule: 30 days ═══ PATH 2: Variant HTML content (Visual Editor) ═══ Variant: Control (3 steps) HTML target selector: .onboarding-checklist Replacement HTML:

Get started in 3 steps

  1. Connect your data
  2. Invite your team
  3. Create your first report
Variant: B (5 steps) Same wrapper, add 2 additional
  • entries:
  • Set your goals
  • Customize your dashboard
    • Variant: C (7 steps) Same wrapper, add 2 more:
  • Watch the tutorial
  • Configure notifications
    • User refines the step copy, icons, and ordering in the Visual Editor. Ensure each step has a stable target_id (step-1, step-2, etc.) so per-step Click on metrics roll up consistently. Taxonomy notes: - The "activation milestone" is project-defined: typically Completed a journey goal for the activation journey. This recipe assumes the activation journey is configured separately. - Session start is the canonical engagement signal.
